artifact_observations.location: Label area on the top face of the cassette
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the label is illegible and distorted. While it mimics the layout of a real label, the characters do not form coherent words and appear melted or garbled, a common AI artifact.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner / Write-protect tab area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The structural details around the bottom right corner, specifically where the write-protect tab and screw holes should be, are muddy and lack crisp geometric definition. The plastic seems to 'melt' into itself rather than having sharp molded edges.
The internal spools lack the precise mechanical detail (teeth/gears) expected of real cassettes. They appear as smooth, vague shapes rather than engineered plastic parts.

Geometric precision of the write-protect tab and screw holes

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label; AI often fails to render coherent text on small objects.
